integrity: The displayed identities are proved analytically; a standard-library numerical checker supplies finite corroboration. Novelty rests on inspected sources and comparison, not a proof that no previous equivalent publication exists. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real scalar-valued Lipschitz extension from Euclidean-cube vertices to one center for 0<alpha<=1; no general full-cube, arbitrary metric, vector-valued, or other-point theorem is claimed. The asymptotic error is for integer dimension tending to infinity. Finite floating-point corroboration is not a formal proof.
title: Exponential snowflake threshold for linear extension from hypercube vertices
